responsibility: This file implements mc’s buffered token stream for multi-pass parsing. It stores lexer output in chained token buckets together with identifier values, integers, comments, exact line/column positions, and include-file provenance; supports reopening a token stream from the start of a pass, inserting synthetic tokens during recovery, peeking ahead for comment attachment, and translating token numbers back to source filenames and nesting depths. It is the core replayable lexing layer used by all mcp* passes and by diagnostic reporting.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation of the mcLexBuf group, defining the token buckets, source-file stack records, buffering, replay, insertion, comment peeking, and token-to-location lookups. The sibling mcLexBuf.def and mcLexBuf.h only expose interfaces for Modula-2 and C respectively.
